name: Andros (symplr)
description: Andros is a comprehensive healthcare credentialing and provider management platform, now part of symplr following the acquisition of Cactus Software. The platform offers end-to-end credentialing workflow management, primary source verification, privileging, and ongoing monitoring. Andros is particularly well-suited for hospitals, health systems, and managed care organizations requiring enterprise-grade credentialing solutions with robust compliance capabilities.

pricing.notes: Andros/symplr pricing is enterprise-focused and requires custom quotes. Typical implementations range from $50,000-$500,000+ annually depending on organization size, number of providers, and modules selected. Implementation fees are additional.

company.acquisition_note: Cactus Software (original Andros developer) acquired by symplr in 2019
company.description: symplr is a leading provider of healthcare operations software, including credentialing, compliance, and workforce management solutions. The company has grown through numerous acquisitions to serve over 400 health systems.

compliance.notes: symplr/Andros maintains NCQA CVO accreditation and supports Joint Commission, DNV, and CMS credentialing requirements

faqs.question: What is Andros credentialing software?
faqs.answer: Andros is an enterprise healthcare credentialing and provider management platform, now part of symplr following the acquisition of Cactus Software in 2019. It provides end-to-end credentialing workflow management, primary source verification, privileging, FPPE/OPPE, and ongoing monitoring for hospitals and health systems.

faqs.question: How much does Andros/symplr credentialing cost?
faqs.answer: Andros/symplr pricing is enterprise-focused with custom quotes based on organization size and needs. Typical implementations range from $50,000-$500,000+ annually depending on the number of providers, modules selected, and whether CVO services are included. Implementation fees are additional.

faqs.question: Is Andros NCQA accredited?
faqs.answer: Yes, symplr (which includes Andros) maintains NCQA CVO accreditation. The platform also supports compliance with Joint Commission, DNV, and CMS credentialing requirements, making it suitable for hospitals requiring robust accreditation support.

faqs.question: Does Andros integrate with Epic and Cerner?
faqs.answer: Yes, Andros/symplr offers integrations with major EHR systems including Epic and Cerner (Oracle Health). It also integrates with CAQH ProView, NPDB, state medical boards, and the broader symplr workforce management suite.
